findings.description: The RDS instance sets publicly_accessible = true, assigning it a public network address. Although its current security-group ingress is VPC-scoped, this unnecessarily exposes the database to internet routing and increases attack surface if security-group rules change or are bypassed.
The RDS instance explicitly sets storage_encrypted = false, leaving database storage, snapshots, and automated backups unencrypted at rest.

The application instance role grants s3:*, ec2:*, and rds:* against every resource. Compromise of the application instance or its role credentials would permit broad control and data access across these AWS services.
